name: Agent use of a host is admitted, measured and bounded by the host service
asks: Agents are restricted from crashing the laptop: every command routes through the machine system's server, git is for version control only, discovery does not scan the disc, resources are bounded, the host's responsiveness is measured, and each crash is traced to the architecture that motivated it.

x-provenance.recorded-by: wsl-host-machine pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not. Existing carriers: wsl-host-service specifications/requirements.md (WSL-1 to WSL-16), rules no-whole-tree-scans-on-bare-cedar-fog, local-agent-fan-out-is-bounded-by-the-laptop, heavy-work-runs-off-the-laptop and bare-cedar-fog-wsl-holds-eight-gigabytes.

board-opening.need: An agent's use of the Bare Cedar Fog host is routed, measured and bounded by the host service, so that agents cannot crash, slow or disable the laptop and the Leader can use it.

requirements.says: The host service shall route every command an agent runs on the host through one admission point on the machine system's server.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "all commands should route through the machine systems' server thus protecting our disc from damage."

requirements.says: The host service shall refuse, at the admission point, a command that walks the whole workspace or filesystem, unless the command is scoped to a named subtree.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11: agents using find, git and grep over the disc crash WSL.

requirements.says: The host service shall confine version-control commands at the admission point to version-control purposes, so that git is not used to search the disc or track a project.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: agents must use git for "nothing except version control".

requirements.says: The discovery service shall answer a question about where the corpus holds a thing from an index, without a scan of the disc.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: the tooling that makes agents blind is to be fixed.

requirements.says: The host service shall place every process an agent starts under a resource ceiling for memory, swap, tasks, CPU weight and disc bandwidth, so that no agent reaches machine resources without restriction.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: agents access the machine's resources "with absolutely no restriction or safeguards"; 2026-09-27: 24 GB of RAM and constant out-of-memory events. The ceilings are WSL-4 of the WSL host service.

requirements.says: The host service shall hold the VM memory at the value in the host record and shall change it only by an edit of that record.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: do not raise WSL; 2026-10-09: 8 GB should be enough. Rule bare-cedar-fog-wsl-holds-eight-gigabytes.

requirements.says: The host service shall measure the Windows host's interactive responsiveness (shell command latency, application start time, input latency, tab load time and message round-trip time to an agent session) and shall record each measurement with its time.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: every shell command takes very long, Edge tabs will not load, the mouse is not smooth, applications will not start, messages to a session arrive late.

requirements.says: The host service shall measure the Windows host's sustained CPU load and temperature while only a browser, a shell and an editor are open, and shall record the largest consumer.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-08-26: the machine is constantly hot with only a browser, a shell and the IDE open.

requirements.says: The host service shall measure the time from an agent's last message to the end of its turn and shall report the hooks and injected context that account for it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-09: turns take long to end; hooks, context injection and memories are to be cleaned up.

requirements.says: The host service shall admit a heavy command (build, install, full-tree read or repair of a divergence) only when no other heavy command is running and shall name the cloud or node alternative for work too wide for the laptop.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: lake build takes heavy resources; 2026-10-08: repairing a divergence is very disc-heavy on WSL; 2026-10-08: more work to the cloud. Rule heavy-work-runs-off-the-laptop.

requirements.says: The host service shall let a Windows foreground application take memory and CPU priority over the WSL virtual machine while the application runs, and shall state the Windows pagefile setting in its host record.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-24: whether WSL can give the Windows foreground application memory and CPU priority, and whether swap on Windows can be disabled when the application chokes on it. The application is a private matter and is not recorded.

requirements.says: The host service shall write, after each host crash, a record naming the resource that ran out, the commands running at the time and the architectural cause, and the repair shall address the cause.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: "figure out the stupid architecture that motivated breaking them and make sure that stupid architecture is fixed"; 2026-10-06: examine thoroughly.

requirements.says: The failure record of R12 shall state whether the router or modem restarted during the crash.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: a crash also took down the router and modem.

requirements.says: The host service shall include in its host record the Windows-side clean-up (pagefile, vendor software, PATH, disc compaction) and shall report each item as applied or not applied.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: Windows itself probably needs cleaning up. The script tune-windows.ps1 was written and never run.
